prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer based only on your location and the search results. A practical next step is to speak with **two or three Pleasanton-area injury firms** and compare who would actually handle your case. Options to consider include:

- **O’Connor, Runckel & O’Malley** — serves Pleasanton; its site offers free consultations. [Firm website](https://www.orolawfirm.com/pleasanton-personal-injury-lawyer)
- **The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch** — based in Pleasanton and lists car accidents among its practice areas. [Profile and contact details](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94588-ca-stephen-fuerch-87204.html)
- **GJEL Accident Attorneys** — offers a free case review for Pleasanton crashes. [Pleasanton page](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton)

These are starting points, not endorsements; directory listings and testimonials don’t establish who will be the right fit. Before hiring anyone, check the lawyer’s current license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/attorneysearch), and ask:

1. Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
2. Have you handled cases like mine, including similar injuries or disputed fault?
3. What is the contingency fee, and what case costs could I owe?
4. What happens if the insurance company won’t make a fair offer?

Don’t sign until you understand the fee agreement. If you’re injured, prioritize medical care and keep records of treatment, expenses, and communications.
